reasons.text: Energy charges do not match units x tariff on 100% of bills (worst bill charged 54% of expected)
Certificates claim more than the declared monthly capacity in 91% of months
100% of certificate tonnes were sold below the cost of recycling (average 0.59x the cost floor)
19% of purchase invoices have suspiciously round tonnages (typical plant: about 2%)
Certificates sold at 0.59x the market median price
Company was only 171 days old when it registered under EPR

inspection_checklist: Verify the electricity bills directly with the DISCOM (units, tariff, amount); the uploaded copies do not reconcile.
Check installed machinery and shift records against the declared capacity; request production registers for the flagged months.
Ask for the plant's cost sheet; certificates priced below the cost of recycling imply the processing cost was never incurred.
Physically verify a sample of purchase invoices with the sellers (weighbridge slips, e-way bills, vehicle logs).
Check the company's incorporation and registration history and the source of its capital.
